info.name: Mousa Store API
info.description:
Postman Collection for Mousa Store Laravel API (unified single-price & variants architecture).

Base URL: https://mousa-store.fourthpyramidagcy.com

Auto-variables:
- Register / Login / Refresh automatically update {{token}} and {{refresh_token}}.
- Forgot Password verify code automatically updates {{reset_token}}.
- Change {{lang}} between "ar" and "en" to switch Accept-Language.

request.description: All fields are nullable. Include email, current_password, password, password_confirmation when updating email or password.
Legacy misspelled alias /api/v1/latset-product also remains supported.

item.name: Get Filter Metadata (Attributes, Brands, Price Range)

query.description: Allowed: popular, a_z, z_a, low_high, high_low, latest, offers

request.description: Pass either token or user_id. Optional type / data object.
